# Gelabber v0.7.0

Integrated through the feature PRs #222, #225-#237, #256-#266, #270-#273 and
#275 and the syncs of `main` (#249 with #224, #274 with #269) into `v0.7`, and
the version PR into `main`.

**Operators: read "Upgrade notes" first.** Seven database migrations run on
the first start (no rollback without a backup), the API signs in to MinIO as
its own bucket user once you take the new `compose.yaml`, and link previews
make the server fetch linked pages unless you turn them off.

## Chat

- Messages support Markdown: bold, italics, strikethrough, inline code, code
  blocks, quotes, lists and clickable links (#257).
- Reply to a message: the reply shows an excerpt of the original, a click
  jumps to it (#262). A reply to a deleted message says so.
- Up to 10 attachments per message, 25 MiB each and 100 MiB together, more
  file types, and inline players for audio and video (#265). Uploads are
  checked by their content, not only by their name, and count against a daily
  quota per user (`API_UPLOAD_QUOTA_BYTES_PER_DAY`, default 1 GiB).
- Link previews with title, description and image; YouTube links show a
  thumbnail and load the player (from `youtube-nocookie.com`) only on click
  (#264). The server fetches the pages and images itself, so browsers never
  contact the linked site. Authors and moderators can remove the previews of
  a message.
- GIF search and trending in chat and direct messages through KLIPY, relayed
  by the server (#232). Off until the operator sets a KLIPY key.

## Mentions and notifications

- `@name`, `@everyone` and `@here` mentions, highlighted in the message, with
  a mention count per channel and server (#261, #273). `@everyone` and
  `@here` need the new server permission **"@everyone und @here"**.
- Notification levels per server and channel (all messages, mentions only,
  nothing) and mutes, also for a limited time (#261).
- Read state syncs across devices; a server or everything can be marked as
  read at once (#263).
- Unread state in the tab title, the taskbar and the tray, a message sound,
  and notifications only for conversations you are not looking at (#256).
- Web Push for direct messages and mentions while Gelabber is closed, on
  phones too (iPhone/iPad only from the home screen, iOS 16.4 or later)
  (#266). Off until the operator sets VAPID keys.

## Profiles

- Profile cards with banner (colour or uploaded picture), accent colour,
  avatar decoration, pronouns, status text and bio (#229).

## Calls

- Per-user volume (0-200 %) and local mute for anyone in the call (#258).
- Auto-Gain is on by default and playback goes up to 200 % (#222). In the
  browser, use headphones above 100 %: others may hear their own echo
  otherwise.
- A green ring on avatars and camera tiles shows who is speaking (#226).

## Interface and performance

- In-app confirm dialogs instead of the browser's `window.confirm` for
  destructive actions and theme changes (#230, #233).
- Bigger Kick/Ban buttons named after the member (#234), one Tab stop per
  sidebar row with arrow keys to edit/delete (#236), phone layout fixes for
  search, the DM list and permission checkboxes (#231).
- "Erneut versuchen" instead of a blank screen when a server or the DM list
  fails to load (#225). No 500 ms blank screen on cold start (#227);
  mediasoup-client loads with the first call, not with the app (#228).
- Gateway: queued frames go out in batches, and a mass reconnect sends one
  presence frame per user (#235, #237).

## Desktop apps

- **Windows updates itself from this release on** (#259, #275). The app
  checks the latest GitHub release every 6 hours (switchable on the setup
  page), shows a notice, and installs the update only after you confirm and
  never during a call. The installer's update signature is checked against
  the key the app was built with. **Install 0.7.0 by hand once**: 0.6.x has
  no updater. The installer is still not Authenticode-signed (SmartScreen
  warns as before).
- A second start of the app shows the existing window instead of a second
  instance (#270).
- Closed producers and consumers release their transceivers, so long calls
  with many stream switches no longer pile up media lines (#271).
- Linux: no in-app updater; `yay -Syu` / `pacman -Syu` brings the update from
  the `[gelabber]` repository.

## Upgrade notes

- **Make a backup first** (`deploy/backup.sh`, see "Backup" in
  `deploy/README.md`) or pause Watchtower: servers that follow `latest`
  through Watchtower update as soon as the `Release` workflow moves the
  `latest` aliases, and the migrations below run on the first start.
- **Migrations 0012-0017 and 0019** (there is no 0018) add columns to
  `messages` (`gif`, `mentions`, `mentions_everyone`, `reply_to`,
  `suppress_embeds`) and `users` (profile fields), and the tables
  `notification_settings`, `push_subscriptions`, `link_previews` and
  `message_previews`. They only add; nothing is rewritten, so the first start
  is quick. An older API does not start against the migrated database
  (SQLx ledger): **rollback to v0.6.x only by restoring the backup**.
- **The image set** (`GELABBER_{API,WEB,MEDIA}_IMAGE`) moves to `v0.7.0`
  together; do not mix versions. The new web client's push setup and the
  `vapid-keys` command need the v0.7.0 API.
- **MinIO bucket user (#196).** Nothing breaks if you only pull the new
  images: under the old `compose.yaml` the API still accepts
  `MINIO_ROOT_USER` / `MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD` and logs a warning that it runs as
  root. To switch, update the checkout to `v0.7.0`, add a password and start
  the stack:

  ```bash
  cd deploy/compose
  grep -q '^MINIO_APP_PASSWORD=' .env || echo "MINIO_APP_PASSWORD=$(openssl rand -hex 24)" >> .env
  docker compose up -d
  docker compose logs minio-init   # ends with "MinIO user gelabber-api may use bucket gelabber only."
  ```

  The new one-shot service `minio-init` (image
  `ghcr.io/till-und-scholler-ai-slop/gelabber/mc:RELEASE.2025-08-13T08-35-41Z`)
  creates the user and its bucket policy before the API starts. **If it fails
  (for example a `MINIO_APP_PASSWORD` shorter than 8 characters), Compose has
  already removed the old API container and Gelabber is down** until `.env`
  is fixed and `docker compose up -d` runs again. A rollback below v0.7 needs
  the old `compose.yaml` too. Details: `deploy/README.md`, "MinIO user".
- **Web Push** stays off until you set a key pair:

  ```bash
  docker compose run --rm api gelabber-api vapid-keys
  # copy VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY=… into .env, add VAPID_SUBJECT=mailto:you@example.org
  docker compose up -d api
  ```

  Keep the key: a new one silently ends every existing subscription.
  `PUSH_ALLOWED_HOSTS` limits which push services the API posts to (default:
  Google, Mozilla, Microsoft, Apple). See "Push notifications".
- **New permission "@everyone und @here"** (`mention_everyone`, bit 128).
  Owners always have it; existing roles and members do not get it, so grant
  it where `@everyone` and `@here` should notify. `@everyone` / `@here` are
  limited to 3 per author and server in 10 minutes.
- **Link previews are on by default.** The API fetches linked pages from
  public addresses (ports 80/443, private and internal addresses refused), so
  linked sites see the server's IP. `API_LINK_PREVIEWS=false` turns them off;
  `API_LINK_PREVIEW_DENY_HOSTS` adds hosts to refuse;
  `API_RATE_PREVIEW_PER_MIN` (default 10). Preview images are stored in MinIO
  under `previews/`. See "Link previews".
- **GIFs** stay off until `KLIPY_API_KEY` is set. KLIPY's terms require their
  written approval for server-side requests and media proxying; get it before
  setting the key. See "GIFs".
- **Own Content-Security-Policy:** the YouTube player needs
  `frame-src https://www.youtube-nocookie.com`. The stack itself sets none.
- **Desktop:** the Windows installer and `latest.json` are attached to this
  release; publish a later hotfix of an older line with `--latest=false`, or
  the 0.7 apps stop seeing updates (`desktop/README.md`, "Updates").

## Open

- Not tested on physical devices: no call with two devices over the
  internet with TURN, no Web Push on a real Android phone or iPhone, no
  Windows update from one release to the next (possible only from the
  release after this one), Linux and Windows apps with this web client.
- Follow-ups from the mentions and push review: #276, #277.
- The open items listed for v0.6.1 remain (#208: existing link avatars still
  load from third-party sites).
